Dead or Alive 2 Ultimate.name: Dead or Alive 2 Ultimate
Dead or Alive 2 Ultimate.summary: Dead or Alive 2 Ultimate is a compilation fighting game. The compilation contains the Sega Saturn version of Dead or Alive and an enhanced remake of Dead or Alive 2 which utilized the Dead or Alive Xtreme Beach Volleyball graphics engine and offered Dead or Alive 3 game mechanics, new game content, online multiplayer capabilities and the inclusion of Hitomi as a playable character.

Gladius.name: Gladius
Gladius.summary: Gladius is a turn-based gladiatorial RPG. Players try to build a championship gladiator school by gaining experience through fighting battles in the arenas and recruiting new members.
